capabilities: Write with pens, highlighter, eraser, lasso and shapes on paged notebooks
Transcribe handwriting to Markdown text pages with Azure AI Vision
Keep drawings live as figures on the text page
Annotate PDFs and images, export annotated PDF or notebook
Import arXiv papers and turn Mermaid or Excalidraw libraries into ink
disambiguation: Not a drawing-only plugin: its main output is a Markdown text page paired with each ink page, and handwriting recognition needs your own Azure key.
extras: Free, no account, no telemetry; works offline except handwriting recognition and arXiv search/download. Instant ink on Boox is beta and requires the separate Bridge app matching the plugin build. Earlier versions (up to 1.4) were built on Excalidraw and offer a conversion command. Azure key is stored in the vault at .obsidian/plugins/ink-notebook/data.json. Developer docs in docs/development.md and docs/architecture.md.
problem: Obsidian has no way to write by hand on paper-like pages and get the notes back as editable Markdown.

relations.evidence: Ink Notebook's own pen engine (Excalidraw is no longer needed)
the library of the Excalidraw plugin if you use it
Handwritten notebooks in Obsidian that feel like the Boox Notes app
Paper templates like in GoodNotes and Boox Notes
Install and enable BRAT from Community plugins → Browse.

summary: Handwriting notebook plugin with a pen engine, paper pages, and a text page that transcribes ink to Markdown via Azure AI Vision.
